purpose: Compile ordinary-language creation intent into an explicit direction contract, compare installed capability routes by sufficiency rather than mere compatibility, infer one exact live route only when complete inputs and unique semantic evidence make that selection unambiguous, compose a bounded production graph otherwise, and run supplied temporary candidate overlays without changing canonical UC.

properties.direction_contract: optional explicit overrides for the normalized direction fields
properties.kind: optional exact live creation kind to test against the direction contract
properties.inputs: optional exact inputs for the selected live route
properties.execute: optional boolean; a sufficient exact route executes by default
properties.candidate_instance: optional detached candidate overlay with one to four testable manifests, isolated workspace, execution inputs, and disposition

contains: purpose, deliverables, medium, dimensionality, motion, subjects, environment, interaction, platform/use, quality, editability, reusable assets, provenance, constraints, verification and ambiguity
COMPATIBLE_AND_SUFFICIENT, COMPATIBLE_BUT_INSUFFICIENT, INCOMPATIBLE or UNKNOWN_HOLD per candidate route
bounded production graph derived from installed capability manifests
optional isolated temporary candidate test/execution/disposition receipt
before/after digest evidence that canonical live manifests were not changed by a temporary candidate

relationships: reads current live manifests rather than maintaining a second capability registry
treats a produced artifact as insufficient when the direction contract is not covered
keeps temporary candidate overlays detached from installation, registration, routing and CANON
may infer one exact route without an internal kind only when required inputs are complete, contradictions are absent, semantic overlap is meaningful, and the best installed route is unique
never auto-executes an ambiguous tie or a multi-step composition graph
limitations: Natural-language compilation is bounded deterministic extraction, not general semantic understanding.
A composed graph is a manifest-grounded plan until exact inputs execute every step and requested verification is observed.
High quality, human acceptance, tracked-input behavior and AI-collaborator behavior remain HOLD unless exact evidence-bearing contracts are supplied.
Temporary candidate instances never install, register, route, merge, release or enter CANON automatically.
Unique-route inference is routing convenience, not semantic proof; the executed route still retains its own evidence and acceptance boundaries.
